messages:
Ashley Rivera: Heads-up — CI alerted on eval-runner for the quantized-mt model after the recent promptset updates. Failing tests look like duplicated examples leaking from synthetic augmentation into validation.
Dmitri Kozlov: ugh. Which job? link: https://ci.redwood/test/5823
ci-bot: Job 5823 failed · eval-runner-quantized-mt · see logs: /artifacts/5823/log.txt
Ashley Rivera: root log snippet: ```AssertionError: unexpected overlap: 42 samples duplicated between train and val
  overlapping_ids[:5] = ["synth_2026_42","synth_2026_19","synth_2026_07","synth_2026_03","synth_2026_99"]```
Maya Patel: I pushed a small change to prompt-augmenter yesterday to dedupe by prompt text, but forgot to include the seed-stable hashing. The augmenter writes to shards/ and the naming uses a timestamp-based id. That can collide across runs and then the split script picks them up.
Kevin Zhou: can we add a cheap file-level fingerprint check to CI? e.g., compute sha1 of prompt text and assert no overlap with val set. Quick guard.
Chris Nguyen: also saw the runner load cache mismatch for quantized variants in the same run — might be unrelated but could mask behaviour. Error: "kv-cache keysize mismatch for layer 6" in logs.
Dmitri Kozlov: let's triage: 1) stop flaky augmenter commit (roll back), 2) add CI dedupe check, 3) re-run eval-runner with fresh sharding. Anyone want to grab 1?
Maya Patel: I will revert the augment commit (PR 892) and open a follow-up with deterministic ids. On it now.
Ashley Rivera: thanks. Kevin — can you prototype the fingerprint CI check? A small pytest that loads prompt ids and asserts intersection == 0.
Kevin Zhou: yep, I'll open a tiny PR adding tests/eval/ci_dedupe_check.py. Will include a fixture that points to canonical promptset manifest.
eval-bot: Metric drift detected: BLEU delta = -0.8 on quantized-mt (post-failure baseline). Recording issue: https://tracker/redwood/ML-1218
Ashley Rivera: summary action items: Maya revert PR, Kevin CI check, Dmitri schedule rerun once PRs merge. I'll post an incident note if the rerun still shows overlap. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: reverted, PR 893 is the revert. Will follow up with deterministic-id patch later. :white_check_mark:
Kevin Zhou: PR 894 created for CI dedupe (adds sha1 guard). Tests added.
Dmitri Kozlov: re-run queued (job 5824). I'll monitor kv-cache mismatch separately.
ci-bot: Job 5824 queued · eval-runner-quantized-mt
Ashley Rivera: excellent — thanks all. If 5824 passes, let's add the dedupe check to the release gating for promptset changes.
Chris Nguyen: noted the kv-cache issue — opening a separate thread in eng-runtime.
Ashley Rivera: closing thread here once 5824 finishes.
